crossRefs.note: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are…
“Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like…
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for…
Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ…
You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has…
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?

translations.web: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
translations.bsb: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
translations.kjv: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret
translations.asv: Who can discern his errors? Clear thou me from hidden faults.
